caption:
Holiday shopping forecast: $1.013 trillion. 🎁
The National Retail Federation expects November-December sales to rise 4.2%, and says nearly half of that growth comes from higher prices rather than people buying more.
It also expects 69% of shoppers (about 126 million) to shop on Black Friday.
Are you shopping Black Friday or avoiding it?
first_comment: Black Friday: in the stores, online, or skipping it? 👇
